虚构集合住宅（3 层，6 户）: Fictional multi-family residential building (3 storeys, 6 flats)
TUM《BIM Fundamentals》2025 夏季学期的学生作业，建筑是虚: Student coursework from TUM's 'BIM Fundamentals' course, summer semester 2025; the building is fictional.
Revit 2025 德语版导出。坐标 48.1391, 11.5802 和 “: Exported from the German version of Revit 2025. The coordinates 48.1391, 11.5802 and “Projektadresse, München” are German template defaults.
Ground / First / Second Floor + Roof，层高: Ground / First / Second Floor + Roof, storey height 3.4 m. No dwelling units are defined in the model; as inferred in the ground truth, there are 2 flats per floor, 6 in total, with an inner courtyard between the two pitched-roof wings.
外立面大面积是幕墙（42 个 IfcCurtainWall），普通窗只有 10: Most of the façade is curtain wall (42 IfcCurtainWall); there are only 10 ordinary windows.
两层双拼住宅（A / B 两户）: Two-storey duplex house (two units, A / B)
NIBS / buildingSMART alliance 发布的 “Commo: One of the “Common BIM Files” published by NIBS / buildingSMART alliance. The same set also includes a medical clinic and an office building, i.e. dental_clinic and wbdg_office in the benchmark.
原为学生设计竞赛作品，2009 年 12 月首次用于 COBie Challen: Originally a student design competition entry; first used for the COBie Challenge in December 2009, it is one of the most widely used IFC test models.
Revit Architecture 2011 导出，经 Solibri IFC: Exported from Revit Architecture 2011 and processed with Solibri IFC Optimizer; IFC2x3.
坐标 41.874, −87.639 与 “Enter address here: The coordinates 41.874, −87.639 and “Enter address here, Chicago, IL” are template defaults.
KIT IAI 的 “AC20-FZK-Haus”，最经典的 IFC 教学和测试: KIT IAI's “AC20-FZK-Haus”, one of the classic IFC teaching and test models; a fictional detached house.
ArchiCAD 20 导出。一层 + 坡屋顶阁楼（Dachgeschoss 在: Exported from ArchiCAD 20. One storey + attic under a pitched roof (Dachgeschoss at +2.70 m).
坐标 49.1004, 8.4365 在 KIT 北校区（Eggenstein-: The coordinates 49.1004, 8.4365 are near KIT Campus North (Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen), elevation 110 m. The use of the IfcBuilding is tagged as CityGML 1000 (residential).
Autodesk Revit 2014 自带的样例项目 “Sample Hous: The sample project “Sample House” shipped with Autodesk Revit 2014, designed by the architect Samuel Macalister, with an area of approx. 300 m².
分成“起居”和“卧室”两个体量，厨房和餐厅室内外连通。原设计是推拉门，后来改成了: Divided into two volumes, “living” and “bedroom”; the kitchen and dining room connect indoors and outdoors. The original design had sliding doors, which were later changed to curtain walls.
坐标 42.213, −71.034 和 “Enter address here: The coordinates 42.213, −71.034 and “Enter address here, Boston, MA” are Revit template defaults.
IfcSpace 没有带面积数量，楼层有 6 个（含 Ceiling、Roof: The IfcSpace entities carry no area quantities; there are 6 storeys (including reference levels such as Ceiling and Roof Line).
Revit 2024 英文版导出。坐标 42.3587, −71.0568 和: Exported from the English version of Revit 2024. The coordinates 42.3587, −71.0568 and “Enter address here…, Boston, MA” are English template defaults.
楼层名 “Mumti” 是南亚常用词，指屋顶楼梯间。: The storey name “Mumti” is a term common in South Asia for a rooftop stair enclosure.
IfcSpace 没有带面积数量，房间面积需要从几何计算。: The IfcSpace entities carry no area quantities; room areas have to be calculated from the geometry.
EG 到 OG4，层高 4.8 m，对办公楼来说偏高。: EG to OG4, storey height 4.8 m, which is on the high side for an office building.
虚构办公楼（5 层，只导出了 3 个楼层对象）: Fictional office building (5 storeys; only 3 storey objects exported)
项目编号 “2018_01” 和地址 “Platzl 9, München” 与: The project number “2018_01” and the address “Platzl 9, München” are exactly the same as in digital_hub, which indicates that it was derived from the DigitalHub model or template.
IFC 只导出了 3rd–5th Floor 三个楼层对象（+11.1 / +1: The IFC exports only three storey objects, 3rd–5th Floor (+11.1 / +14.8 / +18.5 m), but geometrically there are floor slabs at 0.00, 3.70, 7.40, 11.10 and 14.80 m; the elements of the lower floors have been assigned to “3rd Floor”. Storey height 3.7 m.
TUM《BIM Fundamentals》2025 夏季学期的学生作业，项目名: Student coursework from TUM's 'BIM Fundamentals' course, summer semester 2025; project name “BIM_Aufgabe_1_Gebäudetyp_A” (Assignment 1, building type A).
地址 Arcisstraße 21, 80333 München 是 TUM 主: The address Arcisstraße 21, 80333 München is TUM's main campus, and the coordinates 48.1489, 11.5680 match it. The site was specified by the course; the building itself is fictional.
EG 到 OG5，层高 3.7 m，87 个房间，是几个办公楼里最完整的一个。: EG to OG5, storey height 3.7 m, 87 rooms; the most complete of the office buildings.
KIT 自动化与应用信息研究所（IAI）发布的示例，应为 “AC20-Insti: A sample published by KIT's Institute for Automation and Applied Informatics (IAI); presumably “AC20-Institute-Var-2”.
IFC 自述 “No real Project / No real Buildi: The IFC describes itself as “No real Project / No real Building”; it is a fictional building made specifically for testing.
Exported from ArchiCAD 20. Basement + 3 storeys above ground + attic, uniform storey height 3.0 m.
场地 “Gelaende 0815”，坐标 49.15, 8.72（巴登-符腾堡: Site “Gelaende 0815”, coordinates 49.15, 8.72 (around the Kraichgau, Baden-Württemberg); a fictional site set arbitrarily by the author.
办公建筑（地下 1 层 + 地上 2 层）: Office building (1 basement level + 2 storeys above ground)
来自 RWTH Aachen 的数据集 “Technical Report: I: From the RWTH Aachen dataset “Technical Report: IFC Model DigitalHub” (Pauen, Unruh, Schlütter, Siwiecki, Frisch, van Treeck, 2020; DOI 10.18154/RWTH-2020-12381), which contains discipline-specific IFC4 models; only the architectural model is used here.
IFC 里的地址 “Platzl 9, 80331 München” 和坐标 4: The address “Platzl 9, 80331 München” and the coordinates 48.1376, 11.5799 in the IFC are exactly the same as in fantasy_office_building_2; they are presumably the defaults of the German Revit template and do not represent the real location of the building.
楼层：B01 (−3.37 m)、E00 (−0.15 m)、E01 (+3.7: Storeys: B01 (−3.37 m), E00 (−0.15 m), E01 (+3.75 m). There are 62 columns; the structural information is fairly complete.
BIMserver.org 测试文件库里的一个模型，来源和原始设计都没有说明。: A model from the BIMserver.org test file repository; neither its source nor its original design is documented.
Revit Architecture 2011 导出，IFC2x3，项目单位是英: Exported from Revit Architecture 2011, IFC2x3; the project units are feet.
IfcSite 坐标 42.213, −71.033 和地址 “Enter ad: The IfcSite coordinates 42.213, −71.033 and the address “Enter address here, Boston, MA” are both defaults of the English Revit template, not a real location.
只有 6 个 IfcSpace，房间信息很少。: Only 6 IfcSpace entities; very little room information.
